title: Razor Tooth
description: Every time you play an Attack or Skill, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Upgrades are applied immediately when the Attack or Skill is played, and persist for the remainder of combat. Non-upgradable cards (e.g., Powers, Status cards) are unaffected.
